{{Top|leg}}
'''Pubtrans flitters''' were vehicles used as public transport on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]].<ref name="Ultimate Core Dump">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/articles/rx20010816s|text=Ultimate Core Dump|int=Ultimate Core Dump}}</ref> Automated pubtrans flitters were present in the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], one was responsible for a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] accident on [[Skylane T-534D]] that injured [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_3.html|Senator Dod in Five-Speeder Skylane Accident}}</ref>
